# jsal.io

> Personal site of John Salvador, a web developer who works in technical SEO and builds small, free web tools that run entirely in the browser (nothing is uploaded).

## Tools

- [Image Resizer](https://jsal.io/image-resizer/): Resize, crop and convert one image or a whole batch. Presets for 1200 × 628 (blog posts and social share images) and 640 × 420 (smaller feature images), custom sizes, or keep the original size and only convert. Accepts JPG, PNG, WebP and HEIC; saves JPG, PNG or WebP to downloads, a ZIP or a chosen folder.
- [Clean Paste](https://jsal.io/formatter/): Paste content from Word, Google Docs, a web page or HTML code and get clean, minimal HTML. Checks headings and links (drafts, Word bookmarks, vague link text), and copies as formatted text, HTML, plain text or WordPress block markup.
- [CMS Picker](https://jsal.io/cms-picker/): Helps a business choose a CMS. Find my fit: a few questions (what you're making, who builds it, hosting, languages, design, leaving later, monthly budget) give the three best matches, why each fits, what sets them apart, and first steps on each. A profile of each of 13 platforms (WordPress, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, Framer, HubSpot CMS, BigCommerce, Magento, Drupal, Duda, Ghost and Sanity, a headless CMS): what type it is, who it suits, when it is less suited, its main features, its built-in AI tools, who handles hosting and updates, and what you can export. Then a side-by-side comparison in three parts: what it costs to start (price bands from each platform's pricing page), features (a blog, an online store, multiple languages, forms, fully custom design) and SEO (search titles and descriptions, URLs, 301 redirects, your own structured data, noindex and controlling AI crawlers). Each answer is marked as checked against the platform's own docs or not yet verified. General guidance.
- CMS Picker platform pages (https://jsal.io/cms-picker/wordpress/, /shopify/, /wix/, /squarespace/, /webflow/, /framer/, /hubspot/, /bigcommerce/, /magento/, /drupal/, /duda/, /ghost/, /sanity/): one page per platform answering its SEO questions (search titles and descriptions, URLs, 301 redirects, structured data, noindex, AI crawlers), each with the menu path to the setting and a link to the platform's own help page, plus a short profile and what's built in.

- Platform Playbook (https://jsal.io/ic/) is a private, sign-in-only tool for John's team: SEO implementation answers and how-to steps per website platform (Shopify, WordPress, Wix and others). Its content is not public.
